theorems.name: Submission.idod_planar_density_const_nat
theorems.statement: ∀ (P n : ℕ) (S : GeometricCurrentOn (univ : Set (Euclid P)) n) (Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid P)) (c' : ℝ), 1 ≤ n → IsIntegerMultiplicity S → 0 < c' → (∀ y : Euclid P, HasMassDensity S y (Set.indicator (Q : Set (Euclid P)) (fun _ => c') y)) → ∃ m : ℕ, c' = m
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
